messages:
jess: Heads-up — prepping private/VPC airgap delivery for 1.4.7. Need final signoffs on staging mirror sync and installer delta gating. Target window: 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Who's on for signoff?
harry: I'm on. Delta installer preferred to save bandwidth. What's the criteria to fall back to full installer?
sandra: fallback => if manifest hashes differ OR cosign signer changed. Also if any file in /usr/local/bin/launcher changed size by >5% during packaging. Otherwise delta.
lena: we also need to pin image tags in the release notes explicitly. Use `registry.redwood.local/private/relay:1.4.7-rc3` not latest.
jess: agreed. Will add a pinned-images section to the release notes and one-line upgrade guidance.
harry: for staging mirror sync — mirror job shows 98% files synced. Need to re-run rsync for the blobstore to pick up 2 new layers.
ops-bot: mirror-rsync started for bucket `airgap-staging-2026-03` — job id: 84c9bf. ETA ~8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
jess: file checksum for installer after packaging:

```
$ sha256sum dist/rdw-installer-1.4.7.tar.gz
f3a9b1c2d...  rdw-installer-1.4.7.tar.gz
```

sandra: cosign signer rotation note — we've bumped key v2; signature verified locally. If deploybot fails cosign check we must abort and run full republish.
harry: rollback timeline proposal: 30m hold for canary, if errors >1% or latency regresses by >150ms, immediate rollback to 1.4.6 pinned. Is that ok?
jess: ok. Add automated metric check: error-rate and p95 latency via console alert. Also manual abort allowed by release lead.
lena: release-notes snippet ready, will add pinned images and upgrade steps. I'll push to /releases/1.4.7/notes.md in 10m.
ops-bot: deploybot schedule request accepted — canary cohort: 5 hosts in staging, start=2026-03-22T02:00:00Z, rollback-window=30m, target=installer-delta
deploybot: canary step started — group=staging-canary-5, job=deploy-3165432101-1
harry: quick checklist — verify cosign sigs, rsync completed, checksums match, images pinned, release notes pushed, ops oncall aware.
sandra: rsync done ✅, cosign sigs verified ✅, checksums match ✅
jess: great. I'm going to run the final packaging now and will post back with tarball sha and staging logs. :rocket:
